items.duty_text: Combine public benefits applications into a single application to the extent permitted by applicable federal or New York State laws or regulations.
Automatically renew public benefits using information sufficient to maintain continued eligibility, to the extent permitted by applicable federal and New York State laws and regulations.

Provide qualifying public benefits without additional applications when income-tax-filing information is sufficient and no additional information is legally required; provide written notice and information on declining the benefits.

Provide pre-filled applications, renewal applications, secure application URLs where applicable, instructions, and an opportunity to decline paper applications for benefits for which a filer has been pre-qualified.

Notify filers of public benefits for which they have been pre-qualified and provide applicable paper applications, renewal applications, instructions, and online application URLs where applicable, with an opportunity to decline paper applications.

For each individual submitting a public-benefits application, determine other benefits for which the individual qualifies and provide applicable benefits without further applications where legally permitted, including renewal using available information and written notice with decline instructions.

Provide pre-filled applications or renewal applications, instructions, secure online URLs where applicable, and an opportunity to decline paper applications or renewals for benefits for which an individual qualifies.

Provide notice of additional public benefits for which an individual may qualify, applicable applications, application instructions, renewal applications where applicable, online URLs where applicable, and an opportunity to decline paper applications or renewals.
Accept public-benefits applications electronically or by facsimile unless prohibited by federal or New York State law.

To translate all documents into every covered language.
